narrative: Material PL2__MDD08FE8 exhibits erratic demand (CV=0.58) with a statistically significant upward trend of approximately +30.5 units per working day across the observation window. Lead times are volatile (CV=0.64, mean 2.06 days), with transport variability being the dominant uncertainty source at 71%. The current SAP policy holds zero safety stock, creating critical stockout exposure. A continuous-review (r,Q) policy with safety stock of 7,910 units and order quantity of 26,067 units is recommended to achieve the 95% service level target within the 42,751-unit storage constraint.

research_insights.selection_rationale: The (r,Q) model is appropriate for this material given continuous high-volume demand with an upward trend and volatile lead times. The reorder point triggers replenishment when inventory falls to mean demand during lead time plus safety stock, while the fixed order quantity (EOQ-derived) balances ordering and holding costs. The MOQ of 957 units is non-binding as EOQ exceeds it by a factor of 27.
research_insights.boundary_risk: Storage capacity of 42,751 units is not binding: safety_stock (7,910) + order_quantity (26,067) = 33,977 units, leaving 8,775 units of headroom. No capacity-driven policy reduction required.
